detail.title: Prime Number Density and Error Bounds Research
detail.summary: Continued research on prime number distribution, focusing on the Prime Number Theorem (PNT) and its error terms. Previous provisional synthesis is being updated to investigate the implications of specific error bounds on local prime density estimations, as part of the focus on the prime_numbers topic.

children.title: prime number theorem error bounds riemann hypothesis implications density

detail.reason: The next step for this project is to research error bounds in the Prime Number Theorem, which are necessary to refine our understanding of prime density beyond the base PNT approximation.
